name: TheAudioDB metadata and artwork
description: Read artist biographies, reference links, artist portraits and album covers from TheAudioDB, without an account or a paid API key.

apiKey.title: TheAudioDB API key
apiKey.description: API key sent in the URL path. The plugin sends at most one request per second, up to 60 in a minute; TheAudioDB's free tier allows 30 a minute, so a free key can answer 429 during a burst, and a premium key raises the service limit. The public test key 123 works for evaluation.

baseUrl.title: TheAudioDB API base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the v1 JSON API. Point it at a mirror or a test double to keep traffic off theaudiodb.com.
